_about: SEO change ledger: URL (or URL prefix ending in *) -> last date its title, meta description or internal links changed. Do not change the same URL again within 21 days, except for factual errors, broken links, legal/privacy fixes and brand-new pages.

https://luchit.app/model/*.what: breadcrumb brand name now links to the brand page (new pages); titles unchanged

https://luchit.app/model/.what: brand headings link to the brand pages

https://luchit.app/magazine/.what: new article recalls-2026-10 added to the list

_structured_data.what: Article JSON-LD: dateModified, inLanguage, author url, publisher logo (icon-512.png); titles, descriptions and links unchanged
pages.mjs: Dataset JSON-LD gets dateModified and distribution (modelstats.json); lands at the next monthly pages.mjs run, not now

_body.what: 133 model pages: new body section 'ריקולים שפורסמו ל<model>' (the ministry's recall list matched by the app's matcher, text only, no links), inserted after the facts list; titles, descriptions and internal links unchanged. pages.mjs builds it from the catalog-data branch (model-recalls.mjs). Measure: crawled-not-indexed model pages (141 on 2026-10-19) and model-page impressions over 3-4 weeks.
